terms.paragraph: By accessing YokaiVerse, you agree to be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully before creating an account.

AccessAndRegistration.paragraph_1: Access to YokaiVerse is subject to these terms. We reserve the right to modify services or terminate accounts that violate our community standards.

ThirdPartyAIIntegrationAndTranslations.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses a hybrid translation system consisting of human-verified and automated AI processes. Users can integrate their own AI API keys for real-time translation.
ThirdPartyAIIntegrationAndTranslations.paragraph_2: The workflow prioritizes human-verified translations, followed by user AI keys. We do not guarantee the accuracy of AI-generated content.

Advertisements.paragraph_1: Instead of ads based on individual user profiles or behavioral tracking, we use unpersonalized, contextual ads based on content type.

ServiceModification.paragraph_1: We reserve the right to add or remove support for specific Third-Party AI providers at any time without prior notice to the user.

AmendmentsAndModifications.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse reserves the right to modify or renew these Terms entirely at its own discretion at any time. Users will be notified of important changes 7 to 30 days in advance via their registered email or in-site notifications. By registering and continuing to use the service, you give legal consent to these terms. If you do not accept the updated terms, you must stop using the platform.

UserIdentity.paragraph_1: Every user is assigned a unique @username. When an account is deleted, that @username is retired to prevent identity theft and will never be made eligible for registration again.

AgeRestrictions.paragraph_1: By registering, you declare that you are at least 16 years old. Users under 18 are prohibited from participating in Forums or Comments.

ProhibitedConductAndEnforcement.paragraph_1: If a user is found to violate age restrictions, engage in harassment, or attempt to compromise security, their IP address will be permanently blacklisted. New accounts created from a blacklisted IP will be automatically closed. Users are solely responsible for their actions; in case of illegal activities, YokaiVerse will fully cooperate with local law enforcement by providing all available logs and behavioral data without delay.

DataIntegrityAndUserResponsibility_ALT.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses HttpOnly technology for critical keys to prevent access by browser scripts. However, Phase 2 preferences such as themes and settings are stored in Local Storage and remain accessible via the console. Users are strictly warned not to execute third-party code in the browser console (Self-XSS). YokaiVerse is not responsible for data theft or account breaches resulting from user-initiated code execution.

MandatoryParentalControl.paragraph_1: For users between 16 and 18 years old, linking the account to a verified Parent/Guardian account is mandatory. Parents have comprehensive oversight authority, including screen time management, content filtering by tag or genre, and full visibility of viewing history.
MandatoryParentalControl.paragraph_2: The parent account holds administrative authority, meaning the minor cannot change their birth years or sensitive settings without authorization. Parents can also remotely delete the minor's account at any time. These restrictions automatically disable upon turning 18.

ParentalConnectionMechanism_ALT.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses HttpOnly technology for critical keys to prevent access by browser scripts. However, Phase 2 preferences such as themes and settings are stored in Local Storage and remain accessible via the console. Users are strictly warned not to execute third-party code in the browser console (Self-XSS). YokaiVerse is not responsible for data theft or account breaches resulting from user-initiated code execution.

GoverningLawAndDisputeResolution.paragraph_1: Connection between accounts is established using secure, local-based authentication. This is performed via QR Synchronization where the parent scans a code on the minor's device, or a manually entered 10-character alphanumeric code. This ensures authorization occurs through direct interaction, maintaining our commitment to zero-knowledge security protocols.

ConflictOfLaws.header: Conflict of Laws and Global Compliance
ConflictOfLaws.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse is developed and hosted in Turkey; data processing activities are strictly subject to the KVKK law No. 6698. While respecting global privacy principles, YokaiVerse will not comply with foreign regulations contrary to the mandatory provisions of Turkish Law. In case of legal dispute, the laws of the Republic of Turkey shall apply.

privacy.paragraph: YokaiVerse adopts a "Privacy-by-Design" architecture as its core operating philosophy. We believe digital privacy is not a feature but a fundamental right; therefore, our entire infrastructure is built to ensure that your sensitive user data remains solely under your control through advanced encryption and minimalist data collection practices.

encryption.paragraph_1: Our commitment to security starts at the source. All personal data is encrypted locally on your device before reaching our infrastructure. YokaiVerse servers use a Zero-Knowledge Storage model to host only ciphertexts for which we do not possess the decryption keys. This ensures that neither our personnel nor any third party can access or read your private information in plaintext under any circumstances.

dataCollection.header: Data Collection, Usage, and Algorithmic Privacy
dataCollection.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse strictly limits data collection to what is necessary for platform integrity. We retain only mandatory security logs, including IP addresses and login timestamps, for fraud prevention and security auditing. Although diagnostics and error reports are disabled by default, users can manually enable them to help us resolve technical issues. Additionally, while we record in-site actions to improve your browsing experience, this algorithmic tracking is entirely optional and can be turned off at any time from account settings.

APIKeys.header: Secure Use of Third-Party API Keys
APIKeys.paragraph_1: When you integrate your own AI provider keys (such as OpenAI or Gemini), YokaiVerse applies the same strict encryption protocols to this data as it does to personal information. We act as a secure bridge; we do not log the content of requests sent to your AI providers and do not store these keys in a form accessible by our internal systems.

retention.header: Data Retention, Deletion Cycles, and Permanent Eradication
retention.paragraph_1: We enforce a strict "right to be forgotten" policy. Upon a user's request to delete their account, a 15-day period is initiated during which all encrypted personal information and metadata are permanently and irrecoverably destroyed. For active accounts, we enforce a 30-day cleanup cycle where non-essential behavioral data and temporary security logs are automatically purged. Once these periods expire, recovery of data is technically impossible as both encrypted data and associated keys are removed from our infrastructure.

advertising.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse has a strict policy against selling user data. To support the platform, we may share unidentifiable aggregate information with advertising partners. These ads are strictly contextual; meaning rather than individual user tracking or behavioral profiling, they are served solely based on the content currently being viewed.

minorSafety.paragraph_1: For users under 18, YokaiVerse applies a transparent safety framework. When a Parental Control link is active, certain usage data including viewing history and search terms will be accessible by the linked Parent/Guardian account. When the minor account is selected, the user and their legal guardian are deemed to have accepted this visibility designed to provide a safe digital environment for younger audiences.

mandatoryConsent.paragraph_1: To ensure our users are always informed, any update to this Privacy Policy will automatically trigger a reset of all consent statuses. Upon your first login following the update, you will be required to review the revised terms. You will have the option to accept the new policy or reject the changes to continue using the service; upon rejection, a 15-day permanent deletion process for your account and all associated data will be initiated immediately.

BYOKResponsibility.header: International Data Transfers and BYOK Responsibility
BYOKResponsibility.paragraph_1: Content translations through our "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) feature are processed by third-party AI providers according to your custom API configurations. By providing these keys, you accept that your data may be processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence. YokaiVerse acts solely as a technical intermediary and accepts no responsibility for the data processing practices of these external providers.

Self-XSS.paragraph_1: Content translations through our "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) feature are processed by third-party AI providers according to your custom API configurations. By providing these keys, you accept that your data may be processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence. YokaiVerse acts solely as a technical intermediary and accepts no responsibility for the data processing practices of these external providers.

KVKK.header: KVKK Compliance and Data Subject Rights
KVKK.paragraph_1: As a Turkey-based project, YokaiVerse is exclusively subject to the provisions of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK). Regardless of your physical location, you accept that your data is processed in accordance with Turkish legal standards. Users possess the rights to information, correction, and deletion specified in Article 11 of the KVKK. Please note that due to our E2EE (End-to-End Encryption) architecture, we cannot provide "plaintext" versions of your data for access requests as we do not possess the tools to decrypt it.

lawEnforcement.header: Law Enforcement Cooperation and Legal Obligation
lawEnforcement.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse will provide available security logs (IP addresses and timestamps) to the judicial and administrative authorities of the Republic of Turkey upon presentation of a valid legal decision regarding cybercrimes or fraud. Our capability to cooperate is limited by our 30-day cleanup cycle; we can only provide logs available at the time of request. While behavioral data is rapidly deleted, core security logs may be retained longer if required by local laws or to investigate significant security breaches.

storage.paragraph_1: We use a two-tier storage system designed to balance security with performance without using marketing cookies. Tier 1 consists of Security-Critical Cookies (Session Tokens, Encryption Keys, and API Keys) which are encrypted to prevent XSS attacks and protected by HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict flags. Tier 2 keeps non-sensitive preferences such as Dark Mode settings, video player configurations, and UI layouts in Local Storage to provide a seamless and personalized experience on every visit.

dataBreach.header: Data Breach Notification and Global Standards
dataBreach.paragraph_1: In the event of a security breach, YokaiVerse commits to notifying affected users and relevant data protection authorities within the timeframes prescribed by local and international regulations. While bound by the KVKK, we respect the core principles of GDPR (EU) and CCPA/CPRA (US) by offering data portability and deletion rights to users worldwide; thus ensuring our Turkey-based legal foundation never compromises the security of our international community.
